comparison.objective: Encode “hid” in correctly oriented Braille cells using balls; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated ball placement plus spatial-symbol reasoning versus precision mechanical tool use and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: All three letters have correct dot patterns and reader-side orientation versus two safe, repeatable locked damper cycles. No separate specs or cup-placement tolerances are supplied.
comparison.reason: Symbolic spatial assembly is unrelated to dynamic commissioning.
